notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.5 patch
notes.content:
[p]This update adds new features and fixes some issues.
[/p][p]- Possible to equip items to units even when they have 0 action point.[/p][p]  Items removed from a unit with 0 action point cannot be re-equipped until the next turn.[/p][p]- You can now cancel the start of battle by right-clicking on the pre-battle preparation screen.[/p][p]- Sound effects volume reduced by 50%.[/p][p]
- Added translations (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) to some hero profiles.[/p][p]- Fixed other minor issues.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/6b3e54ceb4b7954be8b584ad9ec131803f1740e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.4 patch
notes.content:
[p]This update adds new features and fixes some issues.[/p][p]- Added support for 2560 x 1440 resolution.[/p][p]- Added the function to take screenshots with the F12 key.[/p][p]  However, it is not yet possible to integrate with Steam's functions.[/p][p]  Screenshots taken will be stored in the following folder:[/p][p]  (The drive where the game is installed):[/p][p]   \\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Demigoddess!\\Demigoddess\\save\\screenshot[/p][p]- Added translations (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) to some hero profiles.[/p][p]- Fixed other minor issues.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/a978f9a636b6b2fc08adce0fb8ed87a1bca48946.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 2025 Major Update Roadmap
notes.content:
[p]Thank you very much for all the feedback we've received since release.[/p][p]Based on your feedback, we'd like to announce our roadmap for upcoming major updates to bring you a more fun, exciting, and new gaming experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/5f20b7618b10c6cee9d2bd9ca9e0a5abea54c207.png"][/img][/p][p]\[September][/p][p]・New factions (2 factions)[/p][p]・Custom faction mode enhancements and expansions[/p][p]・Improve enemy AI thinking routines[/p][p]   (More accurate behavior on maps with water terrain, etc.)[/p][p]・Add options for setting starting conditions
[/p][p]\[October][/p][p]・Add a workshop function for MOD[/p][p]
\[December][/p][p]・New factions (2 factions)[/p][p]・New mode featuring a large map with over 64 areas[/p][p]・Multiplayer mode[/p][p] In addition to the above, we will continue to improve and add to (1) UI and graphics, (2) Enemy AI, and (3) multi languages support.[/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.3 patch
notes.content: [p]Fixed several issues that significantly affected gameplay.[/p][p]We are currently receiving a large number of bug reports and are addressing them in order of priority.[/p][p]If a reported issue has not been addressed, please be aware that it is currently being addressed.[/p][p]We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]The translation of the hero profiles is a little behind schedule, but we hope to be able to release them soon, so please wait a little longer.[/p][p][/p][p]- Magic that affects the entire world is now always displayed as an icon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/82c3c4a1d37bc7b168936a478d495341ec1d9900.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.2 patch
notes.content:
Fixed several issues that significantly affected gameplay.

We are currently receiving a large number of bug reports and are addressing them in order of priority.
If a reported issue has not been addressed, please be aware that it is currently being addressed.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

- Improved full-screen functionality.
- Adjusted the effects of some spells in "Book of the Worm". With greater power comes a greater price to pay.

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.1 patch
notes.content:
[p]Fixed several issues that significantly affected gameplay.

We are currently receiving a large number of bug reports and are addressing them in order of priority.
If a reported issue has not been addressed, please be aware that it is currently being addressed.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

We have also started translating the profiles of the general heroes, which are currently untranslated, and plan to complete this translation by the end of August.
[/p][p](August 12, 2025) We have taken measures to address the issue of glitches occurring with the effects of "Treasure map".[/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.1.0 update
notes.content:
[p]This update adds new features and fixes some issues.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where window settings were not being saved.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the 13th skill would not be applied properly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where animal units would not be placed properly with the spellbooks "King of the Forest" and "Nature's Rebellion."[/p][p]- Other minor bugs have been fixed.[/p][p]
- The game can be continued after occupying 32 areas. However, achievements and scores will not be reflected in the battle history.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/a6961b24c93653f55165dacfdf194f64fadc26bd.png"][/img]
- Added a setting to pause CPU actions until the player clicks.[/p][p]Please try this if the window appears too quickly and you miss it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/eef31f47d4fdee9f1a7c77de9269191faeba36ae.gif"][/img][/p][p]-----------------[/p][p]Thank you very much for your reviews, feedback, and bug reports.[/p][p]The development team is reading all of your comments and addressing issues as a priority.[/p][p]Our development team is small, so it may take some time, but we appreciate your understanding.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/278330b46fa018638e51b5a16d59f1af1fd34dd4.jpg"][/img]（Illustration by UNKO-san）[/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! 1.0.2 patch
notes.content: Fixed several issues that significantly affected gameplay, such as freezing when the CPU was in action.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.8.04 Update
notes.content:
[p]This update fixes some issues.
[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the screen was not displayed correctly depending on the DPI scaling settings in Windows.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the detection range of some buttons.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug related to the "Accurate Attack" skill.[/p][p]- Fixed some connection issues between areas.[/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.8.01 Update
notes.content: [p]This update adds new features and fixes some issues.[/p][p]- Updated map screen and battle screen to new version.[/p][p]- Improved button-related UI.[/p][p]- The number of turns remaining for a city that has been plundered is displayed in the area information section.[/p][p]- When the damage of a freezing attack is 0, the negative effect "freezing" will not occur.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed a bug where damage values ​​were sometimes not displayed correctly during magic attacks.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where attack effects would sometimes not display properly when battle animations were slowed down.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the armor icon on the side of the character image was not displayed on some screen resolutions.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that occurred when double-clicking some buttons.[/p][p]- Fixed some connection issues between areas.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.41 Update
notes.content:
This update adds new features and fixes some issues.

- Added a 1366 x 768 resolution mode.
- Added a feature to display the background short story of the leader and some heroes on the unit details screen.
- Added animations for some units.
- Fixed text layout etc.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.34 Update
notes.content:
This update adds new features and fixes some issues.

- Changed the UI (unit parameters).
- Added a function to change the window opening and closing speed and magic effect animation speed.
- Optimized window operation.
- Added a "Now Loading" screen (added illustrations by Gemi Ningen).

- Fixed some connection issues between areas.
- Fixed an issue where more than three magic portals could be built and an error occurred when the enemy occupied the area

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/d0ed9ef993bcef82cc079d7bea05510073089751.png[/img]

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.23 Update
notes.content:
This update adds new features and fixes some issues.

- Negative condition during battle are now displayed in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
- Fixed a bug in which detailed status was not displayed when clicking on a unit's name in screen resolution (1280x768) mode.
- Fixed an issue where some characters were garbled in Traditional Chinese.

- Added a function to display details of various battle enhancements on the pre-battle screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/e70e7d83cf0a3041a4563df84d843b5b9821101d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.11 Update
notes.content:
This update adds new features and fixes some issues.

- Added the following features as map display options:
　"Display area connections" "Display area number"
　"Display area income" "Highlight area with unacted units"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266725/55a0c325d9a140f0f92073bf39b90cf13a2fdf5b.png[/img]

- Fixed some connection issues between areas.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.06 Update
notes.content:
This update mostly fixes some bugs and issues.

- Fixed some bugs related to the "Reincarnation" of "Aiseiri; GreatWitch".
 (Bugs that caused reincarnation into the "Water terrain" and "Mountains" where movement is impossible. 
  Bugs that prevented reincarnation into areas with 12 units)
- Adjusted the effect of "Sign of Doom" in the magic book "Apocalypse of doom"
 (Before: -1 PD, -1 MD, -1 Restoration
  After: -3 PD, -3 MD, -3 Restoration)
- Fixed an issue that caused an error when pressing the Esc key during enemy turn
- Fixed some layout problems that occurred in screen resolution (1280x768) mode

- Added help content (related to equipment)
- Added animations for some units.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.02 Update
notes.content:
This update mostly fixes some bugs and issues.

- Fixed a bug that occurred when the "Mountaineer" or "Adaptability to Water" skills were granted by items.
(A bug that prevented "Mountaineer" and "Adaptability to Water" from being reflected when moving a unit that was mixed with normal flying units)
- Fixed a bug that caused blank spaces in the skill display to appear (filled at the end of the turn).
- Fixed a bug that allowed the "Vampirization" effect to be applied to "Undead".
- Added animations for some units.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.6.00 Update
notes.content:
This update mostly fixes some bugs and issues.

- Set the background color and frame of the icon for each item type to make it easier to distinguish.
  (Items of the same color and frame can be equipped)
- Fixed a bug where the Griffon's action point was not 2
- Fixed a bug where "Monster's Nest" could be built in the same place.
- Fixed a bug where "Transform into Ash Monster" and "Transform into Blood Monster" worked on undead.
- Fixed a bug where heroes' unique abilities remained when they were turned into "Ash Monster" "Blood Monster".
- Added item disposal function.
- Added animations for some units.

notes.title: Demigoddess! Demo 0.5.97 Update
notes.content:
This update mostly fixes some bugs and issues.

- Fixed an issue where tutorials and some fonts were very hard to read on some monitors when in screen resolution (1280x768) mode.
- Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally crash during battle.
- Fixed a bug that prevented "minion" from being summoned in the "Mage Tower".
- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to recruit forest type troops in "Pandemonium".
- Fixed a typo in the name of the "Catacombs".
- Fixed a bug where the spellbook "Blood Feast" was ineffective against heroes.
